title: Cloudflare vs Firebase — Strategic Verdict
verdict: Cloudflare is the stack. Firebase is backup/dormant.

core_decision.statement: Build EVERYTHING on Cloudflare. One stack. One bill. One dashboard. Keep Firebase account alive (it's free) but don't build on it.
core_decision.rationale: Firebase is redundant. Cloudflare's $5/mo paid tier already covers every capability Firebase offers on the free Spark plan, with higher limits and better architecture for OBI.
core_decision.impact: SYSTEM_WIDE — eliminates dual-platform complexity, consolidates to single deploy pipeline

head_to_head.reason: 100x read capacity, SQL is better for student progress tracking, lesson analytics, teacher dashboards

head_to_head.cloudflare: Workers — 10M req/mo, zero cold starts, 300+ edge cities, V8 isolates
head_to_head.firebase: Functions — 125K/mo, cold starts, single region, Node.js only
head_to_head.reason: 80x capacity, zero cold starts, edge-native. OBI already runs on Workers.

head_to_head.cloudflare: OAuth2 in Workers (~50 LOC) + Access (Zero Trust, free 50 users)
head_to_head.reason: Slightly more code but no SDK dependency. Firebase Auth is the ONE genuinely easier thing but not worth second platform.

head_to_head.cloudflare: Pages — unlimited sites, 500 builds/mo free, 300+ edge nodes
head_to_head.firebase: Hosting — 1 per project, 1 build/day on Spark

head_to_head.reason: Zero egress is a permanent cost advantage at scale

head_to_head.cloudflare: AI Gateway (free), Workers AI (10K neurons/day), Vectorize (30M dims/mo), Agents SDK
head_to_head.reason: Not even a contest. Firebase has zero AI infrastructure.

head_to_head.cloudflare: Turnstile (free forever), DDoS (enterprise-grade), WAF, Zero Trust (50 users free)

unique_cloudflare_capabilities.name: Workflows
unique_cloudflare_capabilities.use: Durable multi-step onboarding flows, lesson chains

cost_projection.operational_overhead: 1 dashboard vs 2 dashboards, 2 CLIs, 2 deploy pipelines, 2 auth systems
cost_projection.key_insight: Firebase adds complexity for zero additional capability

when_firebase_makes_sense: Need Firebase Auth drop-in UI for rapid prototyping (OBI is past prototyping)
Need Firestore real-time sync for collaborative feature (D1 + Durable Objects handles this)
Need Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications (Chrome Extension handles natively)
Not already on Cloudflare (already paid and active)

services: D1 — Student data, lesson progress, teacher dashboard
Durable Objects — Session state, conversation memory
KV — Config, feature flags, session tokens
R2 — Audio, media, lesson assets (ZERO egress)

firebase.reserved_for: Emergency backup, future real-time sync if needed

verbatim_quotes.text: Build EVERYTHING on Cloudflare. One stack. One bill. One dashboard. Keep Firebase account alive (it's free) but don't build on it.
Firebase adds complexity for zero additional capability.
Zero egress is a permanent cost advantage at scale.
